desc.en: Cloth made through special processing of animal pelts. It has poor breathability, but it's very tough, and also lighter than armor, making it popular among adventurers who want to travel light.
desc.ja: 動物の皮を用いて特殊な加工を施した布。通気性は悪いがとても丈夫で、鎧と比べて軽いため、身軽に移動したい冒険家には人気がある

desc.en: Causes armor to increase maximum HP. Effect: Maximum HP increases by 15.
desc.ja: 防具に最大ＨＰを上昇させる効果を付与する。効果：最大ＨＰが１５上昇する

desc.en: Causes armor to enhance all stats. Effect: Increases value of base stats by 7％.
desc.ja: 防具に能力を強化する効果を付与する。効果：素の能力値を７％上昇させる

desc.en: Effect: Increases attack power and defense by 10.
desc.ja: 効果：攻撃力・防御力が１０上昇する
